paras: Application: Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5 and Acura Integra Type S (LHD only) Part Type: Dual (PCV + CCV) Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0826-FL

The Radium 20-0826-FL combines the PCV kit (20-0424-FL) and CCV kit (20-0825-FL) for the Civic Type R, and is Radium's recommendation for maximum engine protection. The cans separate oil and moisture from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, helping keep the intake tract, intercooler, throttle body and manifold clean and keeping oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Dual Kit: PCV and CCV circuits covered in one kit
Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock design stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
ft: Radium Engineering Dual Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5
